shots.description_tr: Şafakta sisli bir sahil kasabası; deniz feneri uzakta yanıp sönüyor.
shots.image_prompt: Wide establishing shot of a small misty harbor town at dawn, a lighthouse blinking in the distance, fishing boats resting on calm water. 35mm film, anamorphic, soft grain, muted teal and amber palette
shots.video_prompt: Slow dolly in toward the harbor, gentle waves, drifting fog, lighthouse beam slowly rotating
shots.voiceover: Her sabah aynı ışık, aynı bekleyiş.
